info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Autopays-v3-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Autopay Listing API allows users to retrieve a list of autopay arrangements for utility billing. This endpoint is designed for utility providers and financial institutions looking to manage and display autopay data for customers. With this API, consumers can access essential information about existing autopay setups, enabling them to offer better support and services. Typical use cases include integration with customer management systems and improving user interfaces for billing inquiries.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details of the autopay settings associated with your billing account. It provides information on the parameters and status of the autopay feature.

requestBody.description: Request payload to retrieve billing autopay information. This body is required to specify parameters for the GET request related to autopay settings.

ListUtilityBillingAutopaysRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the AutoPay operations in the billing context. It contains a string value that is expected in the request payload.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.
